10949.author: SupaCLUCK
10949.desc:
Earlier this year, Chainlost reached out to me and asked if I wanted to build in a massive collab called The God of Dorabaebasic. Being someone who admires and frequently builds levels that resemble older styles in GD, I was naturally interested. I decided to go with the first part of segment 12/15, which uses Sourcream as the song and is based on 2.0. 
I replayed the dorabaebasic series prior to building to get some inspiration on how DORABAE built, such as his typical gameplay, structuring, design, and effect habits. 118.author: qmystic
118.desc:
so, i've been playing around with 2.2 triggers, and when i discovered that Event-Link trigger can activate inputs from Left/Right, i immediately had an idea to make a level that would not limit itself to just a single Jump button, which might be a super unusual concept for some players, playtesters has been reporting that "their brain has broke" lol

im not too sure about the deco theme yet, but i want it to be very clean and optimized, somewhat space-ish ig

also, about the difficulty:
I HAVE NO CLUE.
literally.
this is heavily dependent on the player's skillset and ability to adapt and comprehend multiple button presses at once, kind of like osu!mania. the gameplay itself is like insane demon, but it might end up somewhere in the list, considering the +3min length. we'll see. whatever, any (specific) placement in the demonlist is not my priority at all with this project, and i just wanted to make a fun and unique playing experience with this level, so i'll do heavy balancing and playtesting at multiple stages to ensure maximum playability. (if you think you can help with that, hmu)

hope you enjoy!

Normally, I don’t like participating in contests because I feel pressured when making levels. So that same day I started working on the layout, and 40 days later I finished decorating it.

The dynamic of this level is that some parts of the gameplay change randomly. In some sections only the vehicle changes, in others an orb sends you onto a different path, and in some cases the entire section is completely random, which forces you to always be alert and ready to click. Всё самое лучшее случается неожиданно. Готов представить вам полный геймплей своего самого крупного проекта в этой игре (на данный момент). 

Идея сделать приквел к уровню была у меня и моих знакомых еще после полного показа Анамнезиса, когда выяснилось, что в итоговом уровне тематика и сюжет до банальности простые, да и идеи удалось реализовать не все. Поэтому уровню нужна была предыстория, повествование о том, что произошло ДО того как появились руины в самом начале Anamnesis, и почему за нами на протяжении уровня ведётся охота какими то дронами? Все ответы будут скрываться в сюжете ЭТОГО уровня!

В этот раз я учёл почти все ошибки прошлого уровня, мы с гпшерами дали волю фантазии, и теперь в каждом парте есть свои разнообразные фишки, и почва для идей в декоре.

After around a month of constant building, It's finally out. What a journey it has been.

To put into perspective how much work went into this level:
- Its less than half the length of Voyager One (11 minute documentary)
BUT
- Has around the same time spent in editor (around 300 hours)

So for every single second of the level, around 1,2-1,5 hours we're spent on it --- compared to Voyager One, where each second was around 30 minutes of work...
Considering it's length, around 3x as much effort was put into this one and I think it really paid off.

296.author: illybwoy
296.desc:
haha funny cheese part

this is part took longer to make than in roentgen realm, because of how technical jazz is and the intricacies of each note i had to represent. the theming was based on the new super mario bro ds sewer level (shoutout to autumn for noticing that), but in day 2 i realised that visuals dont really matter anymore so i toned down the visuals and underground theme. 

now, i honestly feel like the part should have been better executed, theres so many half baked gimmicks that couldve been expanded upon or made longer, like the gears that reduce the water level (shouldve been easier to miss collecting them), and ESPECIALLY THE CHEESE. if yall didnt know the whole cheese gimmick is that if you touch the cheese the mice instantly home in on you and kill you. i wanted the last wave section to be a whole cheese maze which you had to avoid, inspired by deltarune chapter 2. i didnt do it due to time constraints but i wish i did lmaoo. i also wanted to make the mice do more things, like they couldve easily been in every section of my part if i had time to plan out their mechanics. also if you couldnt tell its pretty rushed overall 💀. 

in the end i still think this is our team’s best entry ever thanks to my talented teammates. definitely our most impressive show of raw gameplay. go check the whole level out its on gyrodog’s channel

3202.desc:
A few months ago, Autodidactic Studios contacted me to check if we could get some levels made for some of their songs. This one in particular is a mashup of "Entering the Stronghold" by Danny Schneidemesser and "Field of Memories" by Waterflame, both songs that are from the old flash game Stick War. As such, it was only natural that this level would be themed off of that game. Selecting a creator to make an art level with lots of different scenery depicting stick men fighting was a bit challenging, but Debihan had made some sick art levels in the past and thus seemed like a promising pick for this task. 3569.author: KiwiPenguin
3569.desc:
MindCap invited me to join ORBIT in early May 2024, and I joined on a whim. I wasn’t very confident that I could make a part up to par in a reasonable amount of time, but I put in the effort and finished with this by early August 2024. Overall, I’m pretty happy with the deco, and I don’t really regret anything about it other than, like, the outlines on the spikes not pulsing and other small things. I think I came up with a lot of great ideas within the restrictions of what the part was meant to be.

For a month after finishing the part, I worried. I heard about other parts going through replacement, and MindCap had asked me if he could get someone to upgrade my part. th04’s part looked completely different than what I expected, and the upgrades to my part were not looking good. He eventually told me that he wanted to replace my part, and ...

4019.author: dobrovich [cherry]
4019.desc:
Этот коллаб изначально строился для Вермира как подарок на день рождения (29.06), но спустя много месяцев заморозки команды, коллаб стал дополнительно ассоциироваться с ирл трудностями Вернама, а точнее весь его пережитый кошмар с 2022-го года. Насколько сложно иметь беззаботное желание и мотивацию хостить уровни в игре про кубики при крайне тяжёлых ирл обстоятельствах?

Как раз подходит образ пещеры - трудный путь в замкнутом пространстве, моральная подавленность из-за обстановки и отсутствие понимания когда это закончится, но не сдаёшься и продолжаешь идти дальше в надежде на лучшее будущее.

После переезда команды на основной дискорд сервер Вернама с бустиками, коллаб был разморожен, доделан и апдейтнут. Чувствую что результат можно сделать ещё лучше, но не хочу зацикливаться и лучше буду размораживать другие идейно-крутые коллабы.

Alright, so this is a layout that I've had in the works for months now. I started this a couple months after Blizzard and I started this with the full intention of trying to decorate for the very first time. However, a change of plans hit. I've had worse burnout on this than I did on blizzard, and I honestly don't think I'll start decorating this as my first. For one, it's a long level and when finished it will be as long as Blizzard. Two, I don't want to start decorating a level this long, especially when it's a bit outside my comfort zone in terms of gameplay. 

I've had a blast making this, and even if I don't decorate this myself, I'll probably try and find someone else to do it. I'm so happy with the song representation and just everything else in this layout. Hopefully I get around to finishing it sometime soon.

4472.desc:
New level!!!! And not Dummywolf lol sorry (it will be finished next month I promise)
My last 2025 level.
I know I'm late to upload this but I would blame rob for rating it too early lmAO. This is probably my fastest demon rate yet. It got rated 1 hour after release.

488.desc:
my first solo in almost 12 months 💀💀💀 an its an XXL!!!!!!

this has to be one of the longest solo projects ive worked on so far, period. thi hasteuly ben ajoure of what started off as a “oh ill just go with minimal visuals and focus on playability” layout turned into a “WHY ARE THERE 16000 OBJECTS” level.

originally i really wanted to recreate the charm of girls like us, down to the gameplay and vibe, thats why the first few parts are quite reminiscent of the horizontal hallways with lyrics. but being exposed to so many new 2.2 techniques has hardwired my brain into trying to make ambitious gameplay while representing the repetitive nature of this song. i hope to have striked a balance between fun to watch AND fun to play.

498.author: Vegtam
498.desc:
It's finished! It feels great to finally release this. While not one of my proudest works, I think it still does a lot of interesting stuff and will be very enjoyable to play. As you can see, I've gone for a more glowy/tech style, which fits the theme of AI and malware. Basically the plot is that you, the player, are a malicious software attempting to hack into Geometry Dash's fictional generative AI model, and stop it from scraping more creators' levels for training data. I believe I've adhered to my resolution to not take too much inspiration from other creators, which is ironic considering this is for a sampling CC. However, the core ideas and style choice are all original, and the samples are only there to strengthen the level concept. 

Hopefully this places higher than the level I made for Audieo's last cc, a stroll at midnight🙏. It

50.author: Viprin
50.desc:
It's nice to see kira9999 releasing a very chill level after how crazy "Alien Dream Emulator" was. This is entirely slow speed without any flashy parts whatsoever. That does put more pressure on the details in the visuals and the overall atmosphere being interesting, which I'd say kira9999 succeeded with here. The entire level is very dark purple and a bit blurry, but the lantern the player holds reveals many neat patterns while mixing in some orange. There are still some light effects added on top, in the form of rain here, which is a natural choice to evoke nostalgia (given the level name). Around the borders, some black clouds get larger as you get further into the level, adding some progression. kira9999 does not change up the designs or decorations much in this, so the entire level feels like one free-flowing section. I can only guess that's why RobTop chose to give this a Featured rating, alongside the slow gameplay, but I personally could have seen this with an Epic rating.

И самое главное — как и во всех работах Султара, в нём прекрасно соблюдается играбельность. Я наблюдал, как этот парт строится в прямом эфире, буквально в реальном времени, и был просто в восторге от того, какое большое внимание Султар уделил тому, чтобы этот геймплей появлялся не просто из головы, из пустоты, а строился вокруг того, какие паттерны кликов буквально нативно просятся под этот сонг. Я не знаю, что будет с остальным геймплеем пока что, но в любом случае — приятного просмотра.

Not long ago, we were advised to pick up this level for decoration because it’s reported to be fun to play, has a great feel to it, and is generally well-loved by the slayer community.

The structures, unfortunately, were a total nightmare — you can see them on the left. They were honestly hideous and completely impossible to decorate. On top of that, there were major camera issues that we also had to fix. Finally, the difficulty wasn't quite right; the level's potential clearly allowed for something much harder than Wasureta difficulty.

We managed to overhaul everything (including the structures, camera, and difficulty) in just 48 hours. 6373.desc:
Surprise! Didnt expect to finish any new level in the near future, but I was told about DemonTime recently and had this undecoed gameplay sitting around. Decided the flow of the layout and its song were both too good to go to waste and wanted to try a more lax design approach again, like I did it back in 2.0 / early 2.1, with less thinking and more building. As such, I didnt plan overthink or redo most designs and I mostly stuck to what I'm used to or to simple ideas. I managed to deco this level in the span of two weeks over reasonably lengthed sittings somehow, which is extremely short compared to my usual works, which can take upwards of 8 months! 

The channel hitting 2k subs was also part of the motivation for this, so we can call it the 2k special as well. Hope you like it, and thanks for the support! :D

6434.desc: After over 9 years since the first preview released on SrGuillester's channel back in November of 2016, one of the most legendary demons in Geometry Dash is finally decorated. No, it's not yet finished, because there is going to be an extension so that the level uses the whole song, which will be built by someone else, not me. This is the fully decorated version of Freedom Dive by SrGuillester, decorated by Azuler, Knobbelboy and Kolros (me). This is by far my best work yet in Geometry Dash in my opinion and this is easily my favorite level I've ever worked on. I can't wait for the extension to be done so this level can finally be called complete, then for this level to be verified and uploaded, putting this near decade long journey to rest....

Long time no see! For those of you who may have thought you would never see an upload from me again, I was one of you for a while. 7690.author: w
7690.desc:
This is another old work started way back in 2.1. I always liked listening to Clubstep; thus, I felt the need of creating a layout with it. Again, I occasionally come back to this and place a few blocks.

As you can see, it is a 1.9 gameplay with tons of fakes and confusing factors. I feel like 1.9 gameplay is inherently simple, you do not have many tools to create mechanically impressive layouts. Instead, I try to implement the fakes in 1.9 to actually blend the old memory levels and my current style (although not that current, this is quite old). This is heavily influenced by Clubstep and Tartarus, as you might recognize.

I really enjoy watching (and playing!) this layout, even in this unfinished state. Especially the implementation of the fakes, I admire. 7937.author: Atomic Rest
7937.desc:
Level ID: 143410071

I understand you probably weren’t expecting this from the same creator who made two of the silliest levels in GD history. I really enjoyed creating Opium, as it was so different from my typical style. I wanted to try something new, focusing on atmosphere, song representation, and symbolism.

I am blessed that substance abuse hasn’t played a significant role in my life, but friends around me that I see every day and care about are in a constant struggle. This level is a story about addiction, but from an outside point of view. Rather than being told from the perspective of the addict, it’s told from the perspective of a family member. I made this level to show how addiction doesn’t just affect oneself, but those around you, and those you love. If you or someone you know is suffering from addiction, this level...

After ~3 years, this level is finally finished! I can't say much other than this project has gone through development hell for a very long time; it was basically a day 1 2.2 project, and was intended to be EXTREMELY long in scope (50+ rooms instead of 9...)

I built my room in very early 2.2, it's somewhat unimpressive (partially due to me not having touched the editor in years at that point), as well as some extremely tight object/group constraints.

I am extremely happy with how this level turned out, massive props to Fungifity and Subwoofer for their work on this. I wish I could have been more involved with the development of this level, but I am happy with my contributions (alongside with helping a lot with testing!).

Glubfuberz is probably the most exciting "new" creator in 2.2 for me personally, and this level proves that once again. However, due to the great color mixing and their animated appearance, they stand out nonetheless. The duality theme is shown through two contrasting settings: one setting being a colorless room scene, and the other setting being a warm and colorful outside environment, where the transition between the two is marked by a line of dominoes. 

Something I’d realized in life is that I shouldn’t be content with just existing on this planet. I spent a whole quarter of college believing I was content, but in reality I was very isolated from everyone. 8916.author: erquillo1
8916.desc:
I started this project in February under the name 'Thin Line'. Initially, it was intended to be one of several low-effort releases on my birthday (4 August), but I quickly became attached to the idea of entering it into the Duality Gauntlet Contest. With Middle Window, I have tried to portray real life and its regular ups and downs.

The level begins with a glass prism, which symbolises how something as dull as white light can transform into a captivating display of colour. In case it wasn't already clear, I tried to associate the monochromatic palette (black and white) with negative feelings, while the colours represent the joy and happiness that we always need. 

The second section features a substantial element: the Eye, which represents how others and you perceive yourself. We sometimes allow the thoughts of others and ourselves to in...

Our hypothetical entry for the Duality Gauntlet, the theme was essentially 2 players, blending two dimensional planes in each section Blocks in 2D and background in 3D, or vice versa, and working with two colors.

Since we’re not kids anymore and live in a third-world country we didn’t have much time to fully focus on the project. Even so, we achieved a very satisfying result for just two months of work on the level.

The deadline and the object limit didn’t match the level of polish we wanted to achieve, so we decided to cancel the entry and finish things more carefully at our own pace.

9057.author: Radar
9057.desc:
Creating with limitations can often lead to some incredibly memorable experiences. Made with entirely 2.0 restrictions, "Princess Demon" by BreadKing, is an outstanding entry for the Duality Gauntlet contest. There are so many original 2.0 levels that this level pays homage to, it’s packed full of nostalgia and creativity. Upon immediate viewing you can tell that this level calls back to a much more primitive time in the game's history, when creators and players often had to use their own imagination and suspend their disbelief to tell what was being shown within levels. It’s immediate to me that this level was made as a love letter to the game and levels within it, showing a deep appreciation for art made inside the editor. 

BreadKing takes the theme of duality and plays on it heavily for the levels theme and story telling. Out of all t...

We ultimately made the decision to cut some parts out of the song, because we knew we weren't going to have the manpower to make the full layout without N3ptune's help.

Hello everyone! I know that many of you were not expecting me to release a new level today, so surprise!!! This level was originally meant to be a low effort project made for my brothers, but as always, I accidentally spent a lot of time on it lol. Surprisingly, this level actually has around the same amount of in-editor hours as my other level 'Touch the Orbs Bub." This style of level is actually so hard to make, and making this level made me gain a lot of respect for other levels that use default blocks in ways that feel uniquely like Geometry Dash. (Ocean of Fish, Dino Level, etc.)
